Hey man, I am intrigued by your statement "UFL consumed before LFL, therefore ITs want higher price".

I would think that 'consumed' is not the same as 'engulfed', and your
statement above would be consistent with RTM's teaching if you replace
the word 'consumed' with 'engulfed'. Why did I say that, because one of
RTM's teachings is that, when we have clean order at the MPL of an UFL,
there is a high chance that price will come back to grab this last bit
of order before making a major drop towards the origin of the up move,
which can be hundreds/thousands of pips below the MPL of UFL.

cheers

AKmoneydeep wrote: I like to keep it simple. Hopefully this makes sense.
posts.fa:
سلام رفیق، جمله‌ات «UFL پیش از LFL مصرف شده، پس IT‌ها قیمت بالاتر می‌خواهند» کنجکاوم کرده.

فکر می‌کنم «مصرف‌شده» با «اینگالف‌شده» یکی نیست، و جملهٔ بالا اگر واژهٔ «مصرف‌شده» را با «اینگالف‌شده» عوض کنی با آموزه‌های RTM سازگار می‌شود. چرا این را گفتم؟ چون یکی از آموزه‌های RTM این است که وقتی در MPL یک UFL سفارش تمیز داریم، احتمال زیادی هست که قیمت برگردد و این آخرین تکهٔ سفارش را هم بردارد، پیش از آنکه ریزش بزرگی به سمت مبدأ حرکت صعودی شروع شود، که می‌تواند صدها/هزاران پیپ پایین‌تر از MPL آن UFL باشد.

درود

Very nice work!

The high of 4 may be a reaction to the absolute MPL of the HTF UFL
created on the breakdown of 1. This MPL can hold more than once on the
way up, and can also be strong on the way back down, due to the MPL.

So, 5, 6 and 7 are equally important. As you've drawn it, 8 is slightly
less important. But, given the pinball nature of price, that doesn't
mean it can't make an enormous bounce.

It's definitely time for a new star for you
